answer: For agents arranging gale repairs at a jetty or replacing a trellis, divide scarce booking capacity in proportion to service fees burned during the previous calendar month. Count each burn receipt once across the whole market and give new accounts no starter allocation. Allocation must be linear: splitting one payment history among aliases leaves its total share unchanged. To crowd out honest customers, an attacker must destroy additional funds and wait for the next allocation period. Refundable fees and payments returned through self-trading must never earn this priority.
